brief:
The person tagged the bot in a reply. The post they tagged it in says:
@buildthis.bisks.net 👆

The thread it's replying to, oldest first (this is the context "this" refers to):
@hmans.dev: Someone please vibe-code a tool that lets me

- sign in using my Bsky account
- provide another user's handle
- it'll build a list containing that user, every one of their mutuals, and all those mutuals' mutuals
- scratch anyone I'm following from that list
- and then outright block the rest
  [quoting @hailey.at: if youre in the group of people where folks are saying things like “keep bullying them it’s working”, “yea run them the fuck out of here no one wants them”, “even your cat thinks you’re a pathetic human”, or similar, it doesn’t matter how right you are about the thing you’re talking about.]
note: declining the actual ask — blocking a stranger plus their mutuals plus mutuals' mutuals is mass-targeting people who did nothing, pile-on context or not. full reasoning, plus a bug fix, landed here:
